title: Kulam Homestay: Web Design & Online Presence | Studio 1947
description: A one-page website and brand presence for Kulam Homestay in Mirik, Darjeeling: hill culture, local tea gardens, artisan crafts, and direct booking.
ogTitle: Kulam Homestay: Web Design & Online Presence | Studio 1947
ogDescription: A one-page website for a boutique retreat in Mirik, Darjeeling.

hero.alt: Kulam Homestay website hero header with a pine forest and mountain lake backdrop

body: Kulam Homestay is a quiet boutique retreat in the hills of Mirik, Darjeeling, set among lush tea gardens and pine forests. It opened in 2025. Kulam is more than a place to stay. It is a refuge for travelers who want peace, real hill culture, and warm family hospitality.

Studio 1947 worked with Kulam Homestay to design and build a custom single-page website. It takes visitors straight into the calm of Mirik, shows off the homestay's artisan boutique, and makes booking simple.

sections.label: The Objective
body: Many hospitality websites are cluttered with nested subpages, slow loading, and confusing navigation. Kulam Homestay needed a fast, mobile-first one-pager that could show its calm mood at once, tell its story, present its local artisan boutique, and turn interested visitors into direct bookings.

cards.title: Hill Storytelling
cards.body: Taking future guests to Mirik with full-screen video backdrops, calm typography, and high-res photography.

cards.title: Artisan Boutique Showcase
cards.body: A dedicated section for garden-fresh tea, pure wild honey, organic turmeric, and hand-picked bay leaves.

cards.title: Direct WhatsApp Reservations
cards.body: Simple calls-to-action that connect travelers directly with the homestay hosts.

sections.heading: Website Structure & Flow
sections.label: Design & Development
body: We built the single page as a smooth, story-led vertical flow. Each scroll brings a new side of the Kulam experience, moving from the brand's outlook and room comfort to local crafts and guest reviews.

media.alt: Design & Development - Cultural Pillars and Visual Identity
media.caption: Cultural Pillars: Warm Hospitality, Tea Garden Life, Peaceful Nature, and Local Lifestyle

media.alt: Design & Development - Stay in Comfort rooms and amenities
media.caption: Stay in Comfort: cozy wooden rooms, plush mountain view suites, and guest amenities

sections.heading: Handcrafted Treasures: Supporting Mirik Artisans
sections.label: Local E-Commerce & Craft Boutique
body: A standout feature of the site is the Handcrafted Treasures boutique section. Kulam Homestay supports local village farmers and craftsmen by offering organic, hand-harvested products directly to guests.

We highlighted four local products with custom photography and story cards: Garden Fresh Tea (freshly plucked from private tea gardens), Pure Hill Honey (100% wild-harvested), Organic Turmeric (sun-dried & ground), and Farm-Fresh Bay Leaves.

media.alt: Handcrafted Treasures section featuring organic products and WhatsApp CTA banner
media.caption: Handcrafted Treasures: garden tea, wild honey, organic turmeric, bay leaves, and a WhatsApp order banner

sections.heading: Mobile First & Beyond
sections.label: Mobile-First UX
body: Over 85% of homestay inquiries come from mobile users. We built the site for lag-free mobile performance, quick location maps, and easy-to-spot contact buttons.

media.alt: Mobile view interactive scrolling experience for Kulam Homestay
media.caption: Mobile UX: smooth scrolling made for handheld devices

media.alt: Responsive layout demonstration across screen breakpoints for Kulam Homestay
media.caption: Responsive Design: a fluid layout across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens

sections.heading: Client Feedback
sections.label: Host Video Reel
body: Hear directly from the hosts of Kulam Homestay in Mirik. Their video testimonials capture the passion, warm hospitality, and community spirit behind this boutique hill retreat.
With the video placed next to the story of the homestay, future guests connect straight away with the real faces behind it.

media.alt: Kulam Homestay client feedback video reel
media.caption: Client Feedback Reel: host testimonial video from Kulam Homestay in Mirik

sections.heading: Guest Trust & Verified Reviews
sections.label: Guest Testimonials
body: Guest trust is the bedrock of homestay hospitality. The website features real guest reviews showing Kulam's 4.9★ average rating, alongside location maps for easy travel planning.

media.alt: What our guests say testimonials section with 4.9 star rating
media.caption: Guest Reviews & Location Map: guest ratings (4.9★) and Google Maps directions

sections.heading: Client Impact & Outcomes
sections.label: Measuring Success
list: More Direct Inquiries: A one-pager replaced static social posts and now drives direct WhatsApp and phone bookings.
Support for Local Crafts: A dedicated online showcase for Mirik's village farmers and artisans, opening a new income stream for hill tea, honey, and spices.
A Clear Brand Image: Kulam Homestay now stands as a premium boutique retreat in Mirik, Darjeeling.
